name: goodmem
description: Persistent memory for AI workflows: store knowledge in access-controlled spaces on your GoodMem instance and retrieve it with semantic search, reranking, and document ingestion.

interface.shortDescription: Give your agent persistent memory: spaces, semantic retrieval, and document ingestion
interface.longDescription: GoodMem gives your agent persistent memory on your own GoodMem instance. Create spaces to hold memories, add memories by ingesting text and documents (with scanned-file OCR on GoodMem Enterprise), and search through them with semantic retrieval. Narrow searches with metadata filters, run deeper multi-round searches for complex questions, and let an LLM summarize the retrieved memories into a direct answer. Rerank results for higher precision, and try different embedding models to find the best fit for your data. Comes with ready-made skills for common memory workflows, plus Python and Java SDK references for building GoodMem into your own applications.
